{
  "name": "richmond",
  "description": "AFC Richmond persona: match HUD above the prompt, Roy Kent sounds, Nelson Road themes, locker-room spinner and status lines, a /timer break screen",
  "author": {
    "name": "Kateryna Kucherenko"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/kaisa-kucherenko/claude-code-flow",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "spinnerSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Spinner verb, seconds",
      "description": "How often the spinner moves to the next verb while a turn runs",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 10
    },
    "toxicityThreshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Extra time, % of context",
      "description": "Where regular time ends and extra time starts, the line to hand the session off; penalties start 10 points past it",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 90
    },
    "breakScreen": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Break screen size",
      "description": "How the /timer break screen opens: a window in the middle of the main monitor, or every monitor covered",
      "options": [
        "window",
        "fullscreen"
      ],
      "default": "window"
    },
    "turnDoneSound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: answer ready",
      "description": "Plays when Claude finishes a turn and nothing runs in the background",
      "options": [
        "bonfire-richmond-till-we-die",
        "dani-football-is-death",
        "dani-football-is-life",
        "jamie-tartt-chant",
        "keeley-well-done",
        "na-na-dani-rojas",
        "roy-fuck-no",
        "roy-kent-chant",
        "roy-lets-go-again",
        "roy-okay-were-done",
        "roy-whistle",
        "so-long-farewell-v1",
        "so-long-farewell-v2",
        "ted-enough-for-today"
      ],
      "default": "roy-lets-go-again"
    },
    "needsYouSound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: needs you",
      "description": "Plays the moment Claude asks for a permission or a question",
      "options": [
        "bonfire-richmond-till-we-die",
        "dani-football-is-death",
        "dani-football-is-life",
        "jamie-tartt-chant",
        "keeley-well-done",
        "na-na-dani-rojas",
        "roy-fuck-no",
        "roy-kent-chant",
        "roy-lets-go-again",
        "roy-okay-were-done",
        "roy-whistle",
        "so-long-farewell-v1",
        "so-long-farewell-v2",
        "ted-enough-for-today"
      ],
      "default": "roy-fuck-no"
    },
    "timerDoneSound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sound: break timer",
      "description": "Plays when the /timer break reminder rings",
      "options": [
        "bonfire-richmond-till-we-die",
        "dani-football-is-death",
        "dani-football-is-life",
        "jamie-tartt-chant",
        "keeley-well-done",
        "na-na-dani-rojas",
        "roy-fuck-no",
        "roy-kent-chant",
        "roy-lets-go-again",
        "roy-okay-were-done",
        "roy-whistle",
        "so-long-farewell-v1",
        "so-long-farewell-v2",
        "ted-enough-for-today"
      ],
      "default": "ted-enough-for-today"
    }
  }
}
